title: Water-in-bisalt electrolytes with mixed hydrophilic and hydrophobic anions for enhanced transport and stability for potassium-ion batteries
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,94-100
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA08378D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Mukhilan Dhasarathaboopathy, Palani Sabhapathy, Burcu Gurkan
Enabled by the fine tuning of the potassium ion solvation through water-in-bisalt approach, wide electrochemical stability and enhanced ionic conductivity are simultaneously achieved in a 36 molal electrolyte suited for potassium batteries.
